title: The Choir of Old Chapel Road
author: Orsen Thornbury
blurb: Dominic Winterbourne, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
